{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent history shows strong upward momentum but true outcome is volatile or corrective.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment indicates bullish momentum.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast 3-5 days later, adjust next forecast downward by 2-5% to account for delayed reaction.",
    "Cap upward forecasts after spikes: if model predicts > 10% above prior peak, reduce by 10-20% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes 0.33 or 0.50 — especially if true outcome is below forecast.",
    "Use sentiment as a filter: if sentiment > 0.50, allow slight upward bias; if < 0.33, apply downward correction even if model is bullish."
  ]
}
